recommendation: Keep this external-repo audit in core. If PA wants the current linked operation page to retain the full FHIR-39005 application, port the bc0518825 out-parameter restructuring or an equivalent OperationOutcome clarification to HL7/admin-incubator.
issue_request: FHIR-39005 was a Published FHIR-core Patient issue resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked for the Patient $merge response example to be a Parameters resource containing at least the input parameters and merged Patient, and for the OperationOutcome out-parameter description to clarify that OperationOutcomes are optional except when preview = true.
initial_application: Core history shows the request was applied before R5: f81504c568640ecff36ef240d3f3812f13c4bff3 changed source/patient/$merge-response.txt from a bare Patient to a Parameters response, and bc0518825da9aee1f84d428e12b00f40103608c2 replaced the single return out parameter with named input, outcome, result, and tracking outputs.
additional_context: The current core branch no longer owns OperationDefinition/Patient-merge. source/patient/list-Patient-operations.xml lists Patient-match and Patient-purge, source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-merge.xml is absent, and b487fdda4bb4a5382a93dbb5a811efd02425b9bc moved Patient merge links to the external HL7/admin-incubator build. That external IG has the corrected Parameters response example, but its OperationDefinition-Patient-merge.xml still has the older single return out parameter and old OperationOutcome bullet.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. Editing the retained core $merge example files would not affect the current core build, and reintroducing the removed OperationDefinition would conflict with the later move to the Administrative Incubator IG.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue requiring the Patient $merge response example to be Parameters and the OperationOutcome wording to clarify optionality except for preview.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final PA decision and establishes the expected correction.

evidence_items.summary: Core R5 commits changed the response example from Patient to Parameters and then replaced the single return out parameter with input, outcome, result, and tracking outputs.
evidence_items.learned: The Jira request was historically applied in core and the later same-day commit captured the editor-supported parameter structure.

evidence_items.summary: The current checkout retains a corrected Parameters response file but the active Patient operations list contains Patient-match and Patient-purge, not Patient-merge.
evidence_items.learned: The corrected response file is not attached to an active core Patient-merge OperationDefinition, so a core source edit would not change the current build.

evidence_items.summary: The 2025 commit removed source/patient/operationdefinition-Patient-merge.xml and relinked Patient merge prose to the Administrative Incubator IG.
evidence_items.learned: The live operation definition moved out of the core source tree after the R5 application.

evidence_items.summary: On 2023-02-23, Brian Postlethwaite described applying FHIR-39005 by defining input, outcome, result, and tracking out parameters; Reinhard Egelkraut and Cooper Thompson agreed with the change direction.
evidence_items.learned: The discussion supports the named out-parameter interpretation used by bc0518825 and does not support a narrower core-only patch now.

evidence_items.summary: The external IG source contains the corrected Parameters response example but still has the old single return out parameter and old OperationOutcome bullet in OperationDefinition-Patient-merge.xml.
evidence_items.learned: Any remaining live correction should be made in HL7/admin-incubator rather than in this core checkout.
